decision_contract: predict close(t+20)/close(t) using only feature rows preceding t; no same-close execution assumption
calendar_policy: Use only actual observed dates of original CSV within 2010–2025. Horizon/lookback count these observations; no imputation, date insertion or backfill. XKRX discrepancy not confirmed missing KRX observations.
checks: empirical target calendar integrity; no target-close imputation
all source-availability bounds precede Korean target cutoffs
future perturbation cannot affect past features
all input dates strictly before target dates
data_limit: User original CSV and Yahoo histories are not point-in-time vintage databases. Audit verifies calendar causality under declared availability bounds, not historical vendor revisions or exact intraday publication timestamps.
